email.title: Add the invited email to this account
email.body: You stay signed in to this same account. We send a 6-digit code to the address to prove the inbox is yours. Once it’s verified, you can also sign in with it using an email code.
email.label: Email address
email.placeholder: The address the invitation was sent to
email.limited: Too many attempts. Try again shortly.
email.error: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
email.note: Nothing is accepted or shared on the way. You review the invitation again afterwards.

code.title: Enter the code
code.body: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
code.label: 6-digit code
code.neverShare: Never share this code. SimpleFit staff will never ask you for it.

notices.sent: Code sent. Check spam if you don’t see it.
notices.resent: We sent a new code. Earlier codes no longer work.
notices.invalid: That code isn’t right. Check the digits and try again.
notices.expired: This code no longer works. Send a new one.
notices.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again shortly.
notices.conflict: This email can’t be added: it belongs to another SimpleFit account. Accounts are never merged. To respond with that email, sign out and sign in with it.
notices.session: Your session ended. Sign in again, then request a new code.
notices.error: We couldn’t confirm the code. Check your connection and try again.

new.title: Email verified
new.body: {email} is now an email of this account. You can also sign in with it using an email code.

already.title: This email is already on your account
already.body: {email} was already verified for this account. Nothing changed.
